# lynxcms/cache

> [!NOTE]
> This is a read-only split of [`packages/cache`](https://github.com/LynxCMS/lynxcms/tree/main/packages/cache) in the [Lynx CMS monorepo](https://github.com/LynxCMS/lynxcms). Open issues and pull requests there. Lynx is not ready for production yet: see its README.

Page cache for Lynx CMS: guest pages stored as HTML, served by the web server or before Laravel's session starts, and cleared when content changes.

## Installing

Lynx is not on Packagist yet: see [Trying it](https://github.com/LynxCMS/lynxcms#trying-it) in the monorepo's README.

[docs/](https://github.com/LynxCMS/lynxcms/tree/main/docs) in the monorepo.
